title: Impact of Medicalized Residential Care (LAM) on the Development of Care Plans for Vulnerable Patients in Palliative Care
official: Impact of Medicalized Residential Care (LAM) on the Development of Care Plans for Vulnerable Patients in Palliative Care: a Qualitative Study
summary: The aim of the research is to identify the factors influencing the development of care plans for vulnerable patients admitted to medicalized care facilities (LAM) and in palliative care.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adult subject (≥18 years old)
* Subject residing in one of the two LAM regions of Alsace (France) at the time of the study and suffering from a palliative-care condition (the nature of the condition (or conditions) is not specified)

Exclusion Criteria:

\- Refusal to participate in the study

sites.f: Service d'Accompagnement et de Soins Palliatifs - CHU de Strasbourg - France
